name: Animus Splinters
description: Expend a large amount of Runic Ward to instantly create a short-lived copy of yourself that uses a Socketed Skill once, then vanishes. This Skill's cost is equal to the total cost of Socketed Skills. The copy cannot perform Channelled, Remote, Cooldown or Conditional Skills, or summon Minions.

stats.text: Gains 100% of Life and Mana Cost as Extra Runic Ward Cost
This Skill's base cost is equal to 200% of the base\ncosts of Socketed Skills
